commit.author: Timo Sulg <timgluz@gmail.com>

changes.title: fix(web): do not publish a card link the bucket cannot serve

lines.content: - Branched from the merge of #584 (`674ccec3`), after #584's own branch was closed by the merge.
- Cards are live under `minimaps/v1/og/{id}.png` and verified by reading all 223 objects back.
An `ocr` review of the merged commit found one real hole and several smaller ones, all in the
pipeline rather than the cards themselves: the pages linked `og/<id>.png` while nothing verified the
card existed (`--verify` enumerated the index, not the pages, so a skipped card step published 111
404s behind a green verify), `jq`'s `add` on an empty index aborted the publisher's arithmetic under
`set -u`, and a page without a card advertised dimensions and an alt for an image it did not have.

changes.title: feat(web): give every problem page a social card

commit.message:
task(web): the cards pipeline could verify a 404 as success

Closes tasks/problem-social-cards (merged as #585 with b79b7c36) and records the
review findings that need code: pages linked og/<id>.png while --verify read the
index rather than the pages, so a skipped card step published 111 404s behind a
green check. tasks/minimap-pipeline-guards carries the fixes (PR #588) and notes
the two review claims that were wrong, so nobody 'fixes' them later.
